subject.title: Control UI: lazy-load optional shell surfaces

question: Should the linked lazy-loading implementation be accepted as the Control UI performance direction after refreshing it against current main?
rationale: The protected label reserves the item for explicit review, and the implementation changes module-loading behavior across several optional Control UI surfaces.

options.title: Review linked PR
options.body: Refresh and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106243 against current main, then land it if its runtime and bundle proof remain valid.

options.title: Narrow the optimization
options.body: Limit lazy loading to fewer surfaces if the shared loader and event-contract changes are broader than the desired performance fix.

options.title: Decline the direction
options.body: Close the paired issue and PR if maintainers prefer eager loading for simplicity or first-use reliability.

recommendation.title: Review linked PR
recommendation.body: Refresh and review https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/106243 against current main, then land it if its runtime and bundle proof remain valid.
